_provenance.note: Every value is copied verbatim from the production API or read out of the run's own recorded portfolio_manager prompt. Nothing is rounded, cleaned up or invented. analyses[] is the API's /candidates/{symbol} `tech` payload for each of the 64 symbols the recorded prompt's Technical Analysis Reports section lists, in that section's order. earnings_analyses[] follows the recorded prompt's Earnings section order, each `analysis` being the API's per-symbol `earnings` payload (form type and filing date checked against the prompt header); the two JUST FILED entries (MAIR, RSG) are queued placeholders, as the prompt showed them. macro_analysis and news_intel are the macro_analyst and news_analyst_morning seats' recorded full_response JSON. account, positions, position_history, recent_performance, memory, yesterday_insights, allowed_buy_symbols and transient_admitted_symbols are parsed out of the recorded prompt; position market_value is qty * the current_price the prompt states, and unrealized_intraday_pnl is 0.0 because the prompt does not state it. what_the_live_desk_did combines the PM and risk seats' recorded responses with the funnel endpoint's counts.

fidelity.method: PortfolioManagerAgent.build_user_message (origin/main as of 2026-09-14) called with exactly the kwargs _pm_selection_invoke passes, and compared section by section (split on '## ' headers) against the run's recorded input_message.

known_differences: Most of the gap in size is the renderer, not the data: build_user_message has changed since 2026-09-02 (earnings no-call roll-up, neutral technical reads shortened, candidate ranking and rotation blocks added). The run-64290730 fixture renders at 87,119 characters through the same code today.

Smart Money Evidence renders 'No material source-backed finding available.' The live run showed eight insider findings (RSG, MAIR, AUGO, CCD, KLAR, IMTX, CHW, CHY). SmartMoneyFinding requires per-transaction SEC observations carrying a source_url that the recorded payloads do not contain, and fabricating them was refused. AUGO, MAIR and RSG therefore carry one fewer source in the registry and agreement blocks than live; all three had a technical read, and AUGO and RSG are still admitted (net +2).
symbol_sectors is absent (yfinance, fetched at runtime), so every symbol's macro stance falls back to the broad equity outlook; the live registry showed e.g. AUGO at macro=neutral.
Proposal Conversion renders its empty-state line: the blocked-proposal history is computed from the production DB and _pm_selection_invoke does not pass it.

Account Status, Recent System Performance, Active News State Changes, Macro Analysis, Earnings, Technical Analysis Reports, the evidence registry and the agreement block differ in wording from the recorded prompt; the analysis rows themselves match (see technical_rows_matching_recorded_prompt).
